direction.camera: Guide attention with noir portrait; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: reserve a quiet text area beside an intimate character portrait; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with quiet dialogue; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with small light.
direction.lighting: single window-like key; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: dark cloth and rain-softened glass; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around slow memory; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use noir portrait,quiet dialogue,deep shadow,serif title,slow memory,small light as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
